contributes.instructions: Plain canvas annotations are provided by the Text plugin as kind mrbavio.text, not HTML inside a viewport. Its payload is {text: "Hello World"}. The text string must contain non-whitespace content and preserves newlines, repeated spaces, emoji and non-Latin text exactly. An agent adds one by writing an item of this kind into the canvas in daydream.json ({id, kind: "mrbavio.text", position, payload}). Text of 60 Unicode characters or fewer omits frame and starts auto-width; give longer text a width-only frame ({width}) of at most 60ch at its size — about 880px at the default 24px — so it wraps without truncation, never one long line. Pasted text gets that frame measured by the browser. People may resize afterward. Double-click typing starts auto-width. Existing items are not changed retroactively. Text uses the app's own typeface (system-ui with sans-serif fallbacks), regular weight, full white, 1.4 line-height and a default 24px size. Cmd/Ctrl+plus (or equals) and Cmd/Ctrl+minus change selected or edited text by 2px down to 2px; fixed widths scale proportionally, explicit heights stay fixed and automatic heights follow the content. Keyboard-adjusted size persists as optional payload.fontSize (positive finite world pixels): omit it for new text and preserve it when round-tripping. No color, weight or typeface customization is available. canvas_state uses the exact text as the summary. The payload accepts only text and optional fontSize. Turning this plugin off preserves text items and their payloads as unknown-kind placeholders.
